definitions.explanation: A building or place that provides a particular service or is used for a particular purpose.

examples.japanese: ⟦スポーツ→スポーツ：04740_supootsu⟧{施設|しせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：01752_riyou⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{施設|しせつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{公共|こうきょう}→公共：11652_koukyou⟧{施設|しせつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work at a public facility.

notes:
{施設|しせつ} is a broad term for any building, complex, or institution set up to serve a particular purpose. It covers everything from public parks to hospitals.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{公共|こうきょう}→公共：11652_koukyou⟧{施設|しせつ}: public facility
- ⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧{施設|しせつ}: medical facility
- ⟦{福祉|ふくし}→福祉：13748_fukushi⟧{施設|しせつ}: welfare facility
- ⟦{宿泊|しゅくはく}→宿泊：03216_shukuhaku⟧{施設|しせつ}: accommodation facility
- ⟦{娯楽|ごらく}→娯楽：00074_goraku⟧{施設|しせつ}: entertainment facility
- ⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧{施設|しせつ}: educational facility

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {施設|しせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用：01752_riyou⟧: to use a facility
- {施設|しせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整備|せいび}する→整備：04037_seibi⟧: to develop/maintain facilities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {施設|しせつ}: emphasizes the purpose-built nature of a place
- ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧: building (physical structure, no implication of purpose)
